{"metadata":{"description":"Per-session environment selector for DeepSeek Harness: Python / R / CLI slots from conda, standalone R, WSL, or custom paths, via /env, session_env, DSH_ENV_* facts, and a header dropdown.","id":"gh:1337242372","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-envsel","slug":"beihzb/dsh-envsel","topics":["conda","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","environment","plugin","python","r","session","wsl"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Per-session environment selector for DeepSeek Harness: Python / R / CLI slots from conda, standalone"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" R, WSL, or custom paths, via /env, session_env, DSH_ENV_* facts, and a header dropdown."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-envsel"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Session environment selector for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Per-language slots — Python, R, CLI tools —"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" each hold one first-priority environment drawn from **conda**, **standalone R** installs, **WSL** d"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"istributions, or **user-pinned custom paths**. Selections are per-session, persisted across restarts"},{"id":"p4s4","text":", and take effect for the model from the very next turn."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This is a **standalone, npm-installable DSH plugin**. It installs with `dsh plugin add` — no source "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"patching, no monorepo checkout."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **`/env` command** — read, assign, clear, and list environments from the chat.
- **`session_env` m"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"odel tool** — the agent can list, select, pin, and unpin environments on its own.
- **Per-turn runti"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"me-context block** — the selection is restated in the model's runtime context on every turn, so the "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"model reads which environment this session runs in instead of having to think to ask. A session with"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" no selection of its own — a delegated subagent, for example — inherits the nearest selecting sessio"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"n it descends from.
- **States the R that a conda env also carries** — when the selected Python envi"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ronment ships `Rscript` of its own, the runtime block says so (`- This environment also provides R: "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"…`). conda environments routinely carry R beside Python, and without that line the model only sees t"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"he R slot and can mix two different R installations. It is omitted when the same install fills both "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"slots.
- **`DSH_ENV_*` shell facts** — every shell call sees `DSH_ENV_PYTHON`, `DSH_ENV_RSCRIPT`, `D"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"SH_ENV_CLI_PREFIX` for the session's selection.
- **Header dropdown** — a per-language selector in t"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"he conversation header (Python / R / CLI tools), with an "Add path" form to pin any interpreter or i"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"nstall directory.
- **Cross-platform discovery** — conda environments, standalone R (Windows `Progra"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"m Files`, macOS framework + Homebrew, Linux `/opt/R`), WSL distributions on Windows, and manually pi"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"nned paths. WSL scanning is skipped automatically on non-Windows hosts.
- **Bilingual UI** — product"},{"id":"p7s16","text":" copy (the `/env` command, the header dropdown, and discovery warnings) follows the DSH interface la"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"nguage: English by default, Chinese when the DSH language preference is set to 中文."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness **0.1.7-rc.1 or newer** (the web profile), which now includes the **0.2.0-rc** li"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ne: every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer is declared as `^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`. Verified on **0.1.7"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"-rc.2**; the range also admits `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`. DSH skips a plugin bu"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ndle whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer range excludes the running runtime, so that range — not a versio"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"n probe — decides whether this plugin loads.
- `pnpm` on PATH (used by `dsh plugin`)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## DSH version compatibility"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Plugin | DeepSeek Harness | Why |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **0.3.1** | **0.2.0-rc.1 or newer** for the runtime-context block; still loads on 0.1.7-rc.1+ with"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"out it | Adds the "- This environment also provides R: …" line, so a selected conda Python environme"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"nt that ships its own `Rscript` is reported instead of being invisible next to the R slot. Rendering"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" only — no new DSH API. |
| **0.3.0** | **0.2.0-rc.1 or newer** for the runtime-context block; still"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" loads on 0.1.7-rc.1+ without it | Renders the selection into the per-turn runtime context and lets "},{"id":"p12s6","text":"a session with no selection inherit the nearest selecting session it descends from, so delegated sub"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"agents keep their parent's environment. The block is contributed through `systemPrompt.context()`, w"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"hose text provider receives the assembling agent as `AssembleContext.agent` — a binding DSH gained i"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"n 0.2.0-rc.1. |
| **0.2.0** | **0.1.7-rc.1 or newer (0.1.7-rc and 0.2.0-rc lines)** | Covers DSH 0.2"},{"id":"p12s10","text":".0-rc: every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer now also admits `^0.2.0-rc.1`, so the startup compatibility g"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"ate no longer skips the bundle. The 18 peers were still pinned to `^0.1.7-rc.1`, whose `<0.2.0` uppe"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"r bound rejects a 0.2.x runtime. |
| **0.1.6** | **0.1.7-rc.1 or newer** | Fixes the header dropdown"},{"id":"p12s13","text":" on 0.1.7: that release renamed the UI icon set (`IconCheckOutline14` became `IconCheckOutlineRegula"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"r`), so 0.1.5's button rendered an undefined element and the slot entry crashed. |
| 0.1.5 | 0.1.7-r"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"c.1 or newer | Emits strict Typert codecs with the `create()` factory that 0.1.7-rc.1 introduced. Ho"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"st-side surfaces (`/env`, `session_env`, `DSH_ENV_*`) work; the header dropdown does not. |
| 0.1.3 "},{"id":"p12s17","text":"and earlier (published) | 0.1.0-rc.7 through 0.1.5-rc.x | Emits the eager `schema` instance those lo"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"ished) | 0.1.0-rc.7 through 0.1.5-rc.x | Emits the eager `schema` instance those loaders validate. |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Restart `dsh web`, open an existing session, and the **Env** dropdown appears in the conversation he"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ader; `/env` and `session_env` work immediately."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Installing from a local checkout instead:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### `/env` command"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### `session_env` tool"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The model can manage selections itself with `action=list|get|set|pin|unpin`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **The runtime-context block needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer.** It is contributed through `systemProm"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"pt.context()`, and the text provider is handed the assembling agent as `AssembleContext.agent` — a b"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"inding DSH added in 0.2.0-rc.1. On 0.1.7-rc the block renders nothing and the selection reaches the "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"model only as `DSH_ENV_*` shell facts plus `/env` and `session_env`; nothing else changes. Set `regi"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"sterContext: false` to turn the block off on any host.
- **Peer-bound to the 0.1.7-rc and 0.2.0-rc l"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"ines.** The plugin declares every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer as `^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` and is v"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"erified up to `0.1.7-rc.2`; the 0.2.0-rc line is covered by that range. On DSH 0.1.0-rc.7 through 0."},{"id":"p25s8","text":"1.5-rc.x install `@beihaizb/dsh-envsel@0.1.3` (the last release published for that line) instead; a "},{"id":"p25s9","text":"future DSH release that changes these APIs — or the Typert artifact contract again — needs a matchin"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"g plugin update. On a line the peer range does not admit, grant an exact-version exemption (`dsh plu"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"gin allow-version`, or the plugin manager) rather than forcing the install.
- **Selections are not p"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"art of the session log.** They survive restarts in `envsel-state.json` but are not replayed from (or"},{"id":"p25s13","text":" carried by) session logs."}],"truncated":true}
